_comment: PAM policy for the Vault stand-in: the master policy and the per-tier platforms in one file.
Read by tools/discover.py (classification), onboard.sh (what to vault, where, which Vault policy),
rotate.sh (dependency gate) and reconcile.sh (rotated within policy?). No secrets here.
Vocabulary: a tier is a Platform (rotation interval, check-out rules); a library set or
static-role prefix plus its Vault policy is a Safe; 'exclusions' are documented Master Policy exceptions.

exclusions.krbtgt: KDC account: reset twice with the krbtgt reset procedure (runbook), never vaulted
exclusions.Administrator: RID-500 built-in: break-glass, held offline under dual control, rotated by the break-glass drill
exclusions.svc-vault-rotator: Vault's own bind (reconcile) account: rotated by ldap/rotate-root, never a static role
exclusions.svc-pam-discovery: read-only discovery bind account: credential in Key Vault for discover.sh

tier0.description: Domain / forest control (Enterprise Access Model control plane)

svc.description: Non-privileged service accounts with SPNs (Kerberoastable: long random passwords, rotated)
